description: Cost broken down by billing component for a deployment: cost_type (datahot/datacontent, datawarm, general-purpose-search, retained_gcp, support, inference, transfer, snapshot, onprem, ...), cost_category (data_tier, platform, transfer, snapshot, support, onprem, other), and whether the component is allocatable to a data stream. Use this to explain WHERE a deployment's money goes and how much of it can be attributed to workloads at all.

configuration.query:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", ts, NOW()) <= ?days AND deployment_id == ?deployment_id
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), currency_unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_unit, "EUR"), COALESCE(cloud_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL cost = total_chargeable_units * rate
| STATS cost = SUM(cost), currency = VALUES(currency_unit) BY cost_type, cost_category, is_allocatable
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 50

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID or Serverless project ID
